fit_line: React and Next.js developer in Pune with 3 years of full-stack experience, responsive UI and REST API work, available immediately.

screening_answers.question: How many years of React.js and Next.js experience do you have?
screening_answers.answer: I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience, and React and Next.js are central to my shipped work: PageForge (Next.js 16, React 19), Lumen, Cairnmoor and Kilnwood Roasters are built with them. Code and live demos are on my portfolio and GitHub.

screening_answers.question: Describe your experience with state management (Redux or Context API).
screening_answers.answer: In Safey Inventory I used TanStack Query for server state in a React 19 app. I have not listed Redux or Context API on my CV, but I can pick up either quickly and would like to learn your conventions.

screening_answers.question: What is your experience with REST APIs and JSON?
screening_answers.answer: At the US-based medical-device company I built full-stack web apps and a CRM. In my projects I have built REST APIs with Node.js and FastAPI, signed webhooks and Stripe flows, and integrated Sanity, Supabase, PostHog and HubSpot. The portfolio backend has 10 end-to-end API tests.

screening_answers.question: How do you handle responsive design and cross-browser compatibility?
screening_answers.answer: I design mobile-first layouts with Tailwind CSS and test on real viewports. Cairnmoor has dedicated mobile layouts and a reduced-motion version, and Lowlight has fallbacks for phones and slow GPUs. I have no formal cross-browser test suite listed, but I check the main browsers before shipping.

screening_answers.question: What is your notice period and expected salary?
screening_answers.answer: My notice period is immediate. I am targeting INR 30,000 per month or more and am flexible on structure. What matters most to me is the work and the total package. I am based in Pune and can work on-site.

paragraphs: I am applying for the React JS Developer role in Pune. I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, where I built and maintained web applications, several apps including a CRM, and internal AI agents.

React and Next.js are the core of my recent work. PageForge is built on Next.js 16 and React 19 with CMS, database, analytics and CRM integrations. Lumen, Cairnmoor and Kilnwood Roasters are Next.js sites with responsive layouts, and Cairnmoor includes a reduced-motion version. My backend work gives me solid REST API and JSON experience, including a portfolio backend with 10 end-to-end API tests.
I am based in Pune, available immediately, and happy to work on-site. Live demos and code are at hussain-singapuri.vercel.app and github.com/huss2003. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
